design.decision: Fight for every trick, including overtricks. Bid up to match, because the multiplier also deepens a set.
design.opponent: Shown on the first trick won. Its value is predictable.
design.rationale: This is the multiplier counterpart to seed-win-points. Expected value tracks tricks won, which tracks contract size, so it supports Bid High without a threshold.
design.draftText: +1 contract multiplier when your team wins a trick

history.note: draft-common: the enumerator also produced this signature (e-win-mult); credited to both sources.
